claim: The board is the same for everyone that day, and every generated board has a verified solution.
sandbox: 366 deterministic seeds; generate twice and solve each with the stored solution

claim: A player can connect the sample board and reach a result card.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; rotate every routed tile to its verified orientation

claim: The game is free to play without an account or payment.
sandbox: fresh /play board; start the timed round and assert no account or payment step appears

claim: A completed board can be shared as a spoiler-safe result link.
sandbox: fresh /demo; solve the board; capture Copy result and assert the link contains no tile layout

claim: Friends can play this exact board at any time.
sandbox: fresh shared seed; copy a room link; open it and compare every tile signature

claim: If clipboard access is blocked, the complete fixed same-board link remains visible and selectable.
sandbox: fresh fixed seed; deny Clipboard API and legacy copy; assert the visible focused field contains seed and room

claim: There is no chat, account, live lobby, or endless puzzle feed.
sandbox: fresh /demo; assert the board is playable immediately and no account, chat, lobby, or feed UI is present

claim: Shared result links include only the seed, time, turns, and result.
where: landing privacy section and privacy page
sandbox: fresh /demo; solve, copy the result, and assert its query fields exactly

claim: A completed run reaches the end screen, and Play again resets its timer, board, turns, result, and settings.
sandbox: fresh /play deterministic board; script the verified solution through the real end screen; restart and assert every initial state

claim: Progress and settings stay on this device.
sandbox: fresh /demo; rotate a tile, reload, and assert the saved turn count

claim: A timed round allows five minutes before the result screen appears.
sandbox: fresh /demo; set elapsed time to 299.8 seconds, reload, and observe the time-ended result

claim: Demo play uses separate storage and does not change the daily game.
sandbox: fresh /demo; interact and assert every storage key begins with demo:

claim: The board works with keyboard controls.
sandbox: fresh /demo; focus a tile, press R, then pause and resume with P

claim: Assist mode removes the timer and stays on this device.
sandbox: fresh /demo; remove the timer, reload, and assert the no-limit state persists

claim: The game does not send gameplay or personal data to another server.
sandbox: fresh /demo with a request log; play and copy a room link; assert all requests are same-origin

claim: Works offline after your first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; load /demo, wait for its service worker, switch offline, and reload

claim: An installed copy activates a changed service worker and loads the current page instead of stale cached HTML.
sandbox: isolated local origin; install the prior cache-first worker, switch server to the repaired worker and page, update, and assert activation plus current content

claim: The active game board sustains at least 45 frames per second in the isolated Chromium performance check.
sandbox: fresh /demo in one isolated Chromium worker; warm up, then measure requestAnimationFrame callbacks for two seconds
